items.t: Plan-area boundaries (planning, not board): per the Willoughby Community Plan Area description in Bylaw No. 6201, the plan area is bordered by the municipal boundary with the City of Surrey to the southwest, Highway 1 to the north, the ridgeline of the Trans Mountain Pipeline right-of-way and Lower Mainland Regional Park and 68 Avenue to the south, and 216 Street and the Willowbrook Connector to the east.

Mountain Secondary, 7633 202A St. Catchments are address-based: the SD35 School Locator check for 7888 200 Street returns Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, Peter Ewart Middle School and R.E. Mountain Secondary.

Parks, transit and health: Langley Events Centre, 7888 200 Street, is a Township-owned multi-purpose sports and events facility with Willoughby Community Park beside it; Muriel Arnason Library is at 130 - 20338 65 Avenue (Fraser Valley Regional Library). Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway, is the Fraser Health community hospital for Langley.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Willoughby

items.t: Township plans — current position: the existing Willoughby Community Plan (Bylaw 1836, 1979) now sits as Schedule 6 to the Township's Official Community Plan as updated by OCP Bylaw 6200, adopted December 1, 2025.

Zoning and small-scale housing: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 applies. Compact R-CL lots range from 220 m² to 464.5 m², with at least 11 m of frontage for front-loaded lots and 8.2 m for lane-access lots. Secondary suites are capped at 120 m², one per home, and need a building permit. Small-scale housing (Bylaw 6020, adopted November 18, 2024) allows 3 units on eligible lots of 280 m² or smaller and 4 on larger eligible lots up to 4,050 m²; bigger lots don't qualify, and there's no 6-unit option.

Yorkson Park is not one building, and the Towers' headline mixes product. Yorkson Park covers several addresses around 86 Avenue and 203A Street, and the directory's 31-unit figure belongs to 20328 86 Avenue only (strata plan EPS7248) — compare fees and reports by strata plan, not by project name. The Towers at Latimer Heights' published "nearly 500 homes" includes townhomes as well as condos, so resale depth for the towers alone is smaller than the headline suggests.

An Elements unit's age follows its building, not the complex. Listings for 20211 66 Avenue give built years from 2013 to 2018 depending on the building (A through F) — age, warranty status and depreciation-report timing follow the specific building.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Willoughby Heights
The Towers at Latimer Heights — Tower A at 8551 201 Street and Tower B at 20065 85 Avenue

Two concrete towers by Vesta Properties, described in a presale-directory summary as Langley's first concrete high-rise condominium community, with nearly 500 homes including condos and townhomes, construction completed in 2024; listings for units in both towers confirm built 2024 and concrete construction.
Latimer Village (Vesta Properties) — low-rise buildings including 20019 83A Avenue, 8380 200A Street and 20052 83A Avenue

Listings describe Latimer Village as part of Vesta's 74-acre Latimer Heights master-planned community; units at 20019 83A Avenue are listed as built in 2022 and units at 8380 200A Street as built in 2023, wood frame.
Yorkson Park (Quadra Homes) — a multi-address low-rise group including 20328 86 Avenue, 20290 86 Avenue, 20376 86 Avenue and 8561 203A Street

The building directory listing for 20328 86 Avenue records complex name Yorkson Park, strata plan EPS7248, built 2021, and 31 units at that one address; listings at the other Yorkson Park addresses show built 2021–2022 and Quadra Homes as builder, with retractable-glass solariums a recurring feature.
Yorkson Downs (Quadra) — 20716 Willoughby Town Centre Drive (buildings A and B)

Listings show condos built in 2019, wood frame, with underground parking; one listing says rentals are allowed and pets are allowed with restrictions. That's one listing, not the bylaws, so confirm on the Form B.
Union Park (Polygon) — 8150 207 Street

A presale directory describes Union Park as four 6-storey wood-frame buildings with 589 condos at 82 Avenue and 208 Street. Listings at 8150 207 Street show condos built in 2021, with underground parking and the 12,000 sq ft Union Club amenity building with an outdoor pool, hot tub and gym.
Yorkson Creek Parkside 2 — 8157 207 Street
Built 2016, 188 units. The directory records the restrictions as: pets allowed with restrictions, rentals allowed. Amenities listed: elevator, exercise centre.
Yorkson Creek — 8328 207A Street
Named in current listings as the building for units at 8328 207A Street, apartment/condo subtype.
Walnut Park (Quadra Homes) — 208 Street and 83 Avenue, Yorkson
A presale directory describes 211 condos and three ground-floor commercial units in two 6-storey wood-frame buildings.
The Hive (Apcon Group) — 7920 206 Street (Hive 1) and 7936 206 Street (Hive 2), Willoughby Town Centre

The Hive is two 6-storey wood-frame buildings with about 240 condos in total; trade press describes an 84-unit first phase and a 156-unit Hive 2. Listings show Hive 1 built in 2024 and Hive 2 in 2025, with underground parking.
Elements — 20211 66 Avenue

A low-rise complex of several buildings (lettered A to F in listings) at the south end of Willoughby. Listings show wood frame and different years by building (2013, 2015, 2017 and 2018), so check the year for the specific building. The amenity building is called the Trilogy Club.
Matteo (ML Emporio) — 7588 198B Street at 76 Avenue
Two 6-storey wood-frame buildings with 212 condos and ground-floor retail, now under construction. The developer's marketing says completion is expected in mid-2028.

items.t: "Willoughby Heights" is the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board's name for this area; the Township of Langley calls it "Willoughby". The proposed Willoughby Community Plan (Bylaw No. 6201) describes the area as bordered by Surrey to the southwest, Highway 1 to the north, the Trans Mountain Pipeline ridgeline, Lower Mainland Regional Park and 68 Avenue to the south, and 216 Street and the Willowbrook Connector to the east.

The condos are in four main clusters: the Latimer Heights / 200 Street corridor around 83–86 Avenue (The Towers, Latimer Village, Yorkson Park and Yorkson Downs); around 208 Street and 82–83 Avenue in Yorkson (Union Park, Yorkson Creek Parkside 2, Yorkson Creek and Walnut Park); Willoughby Town Centre around 206 Street and 80 Avenue (The Hive and Yorkson Downs on Willoughby Town Centre Drive); and the southwest edge (Elements on 66 Avenue, and Matteo at 198B Street and 76 Avenue).

Transit and landmark anchors named in Township and TransLink material are the Langley Events Centre at 7888 200 Street, the Carvolth Exchange area at 200 Street and Highway 1, and routes 501 (Surrey Central–Langley Centre via 200 Street), 372 and 595.

The Willoughby Community Plan Update (Bylaws No. 6201, 6202 and 6203) replaced the old Willoughby Community Plan and created the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan and the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan; the Transit Corridor is the high-density spine where further condo form is planned.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Willoughby Heights

items.t: Zoning: the Township of Langley's Zoning Bylaw 2500 applies. Willoughby's compact lots are in the Residential Compact Lot zone (R-CL), with lots from 220 m² to 464.5 m² and minimum frontages of 11 m (front-loaded) or 8.2 m (rear-loaded). These are the houses and townhouses around the condo buildings.

items.t: The plan changed in 2026-era bylaws: Bylaws No. 6201, 6202 and 6203 replaced the Willoughby Community Plan and created the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan and the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan — what gets built beside a condo bought today follows the new plans, and the Transit Corridor is the designated high-density spine.

The Towers' headline count mixes product types: the published "nearly 500 homes" for The Towers at Latimer Heights includes townhomes as well as condos, so resale depth for the towers alone is smaller than the headline suggests.

Yorkson Park is not one building: the name covers several addresses on and around 86 Avenue and 203A Street (20328, 20290 and 20376 86 Avenue; 8561 203A Street), and the directory's 31-unit figure belongs to 20328 86 Avenue only, strata plan EPS7248. Comparing fees or reports across "Yorkson Park" units without checking which strata plan the unit sits in is a known trap.

Trinity Western University's Smith campus is in southeast Willoughby at 8086 208 Street, and the Township's plan background names a campus expansion in southeast Willoughby — part of the rental-demand backdrop for the Yorkson buildings, stated as context only.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Willoughby?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Willoughby?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.

faq.q: How many known condo projects does Willoughby have?

faq.a: Mostly low-rise. The only concrete high-rise project is The Towers at Latimer Heights (two towers, completed 2024). Union Park, The Hive, Matteo and Walnut Park are 6-storey wood frame, and the older Yorkson and Latimer Village buildings are low-rise wood frame.
faq.q: Is Willoughby mostly towers or low-rise?

faq.a: In the Township's compact lot zone (R-CL), lots run from 220 m² to 464.5 m², with minimum frontages of 11 m for front-loaded lots and 8.2 m for rear-loaded lots. There's no 355 m² figure in the bylaw. A secondary suite can be up to 120 m², one per main home, and needs a permit.
faq.q: What are the compact-lot rules around the condo nodes?

faq.a: For a long-term tenancy, yes — rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable anywhere in BC since November 24, 2022. A short-term rental bylaw can still bind you, and the registered bylaws govern pets. Yorkson Creek Parkside 2 is directory-recorded as rentals allowed in any case.
